name: Dublin
summary: Flat, walkable, and talkative — a capital that works best on foot between Trinity College and the Liffey, with Grafton Street's buskers setting the pace. Two days at either end of a loop around the island is exactly right.
highlights: The Long Room at Trinity College, first entry of the morning
Grafton Street buskers as the shops open
Crossing O'Connell Bridge at dusk, the Liffey going gold
